title: Severe Flooding in Downtown
description: Heavy rainfall has caused the main river to overflow, flooding several blocks in the downtown area. Immediate evacuation recommended.

title: Wildfire Near Northern Ridge
description: A rapidly spreading wildfire is approaching the northern residential ridge. Firefighters are currently establishing a perimeter.

title: Power Grid Failure
description: Substation explosion caused a massive power outage affecting the eastern district. Repair crews are on site.
